title: Thimsy ES-DE/nano/names.json
description: Title overrides, version 1, as Android writes them (saveRomNameOverrides, NanoMenuScraper.cpp). Keys are absolute ROM paths bound to the volume id. Every shipped build prunes an item whose rom path fails stat, so until the Android compatibility floor (interop Q12) Linux never writes this file and keeps titles in the gamelist's <name> (LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.11). Android rebuilds it from structs: no field only one platform knows may live here. Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

legacy_path.description: The forms Android writes and every reader accepts (esdeStoragePath's prefixes).
